name: csv-import
title: CSV import
description: Brings a CSV file into your records in three steps: upload, map its columns to your fields, review what will be skipped and why.

CsvImportMapping.description: The Map columns step on its own, one flat card: a heading row, "Columns in your file → Lead fields", then one row per column, rows divided by a line. A row is the column's name (a check when auto-matched) over its first values, an arrow, and the field's Select, each field led by its type's icon. A required field with no column says so under the heading; a field picked twice marks both Selects and says so in the row. Don't import reads muted, as a placeholder. It lays out by its container's width (`@container` on an ancestor). Other props, `ref` included, go to its root.

props.name: headers
props.description: The column names (csvHeaders).

props.name: rows
props.description: The data rows, for each column's first values (the first three that aren't empty).

props.name: autoMapping
props.description: What auto-match picked, for the Auto-matched checks. Defaults to matchColumns(headers, fields).

props.name: noun
props.description: "lead" / "leads": the heading says "Lead fields". Defaults to the `csvRowNoun` label.

props.name: appIcon
props.description: Your app's mark beside that heading, 16px; give it `className="size-full"`. Defaults to a database glyph.

CsvImportPreview.description: The rows of the Review step on their own: "340 rows · 328 ready · 12 with errors", an Alert grouping the errors by field (each group a link that turns on "Show only errors" and moves focus to its first cell), the checkbox, and a Table of the mapped fields, 100 rows a page with Pagination under it. An invalid cell is in the error colour with a warning mark and its reason (a Tooltip, and read out); with `onCellEdit` it is a button that fixes it in place. Other props, `ref` included, go to its root.

props.name: mapping
props.description: Which columns map to which fields: the table shows the mapped fields.

props.name: validation
props.description: validateCsv's result.

props.name: overLimit
props.description: Rows past `maxRows`, in the summary.

props.name: onCellEdit
props.type: (row: number, column: number, value: string) => void
props.description: Makes every invalid cell a button that opens a field to fix its value (Enter, a click or F2; Enter or leaving the field commits, Escape cancels). Called with the row's number among the data rows (`CsvCheckedRow.n`), the source column's index and the new value: check the rows again with it and pass the new `validation`. Focus then stays on the cell while it is still invalid, or moves to the next invalid cell once the row passes. Without it, nothing is editable.

CsvImportProgress.description: "Importing 120 of 328…" over a Progress bar. Other props, `ref` included, go to its root.

props.name: done
props.description: Rows done.

props.name: total
props.description: Rows to import.

CsvImportResult.description: The outcome of an import as a table: a heading that says it ("328 leads imported · 12 skipped", the focus target, `data-csv-focus="result"`), a SegmentedControl of Imported and Skipped (and Not imported when a run stopped), "Download skipped rows" (a CSV with an `error` column; icon-only under 420px), and the segment's rows, 100 a page. Imported and Not imported show the normalised values sent; Skipped shows a Reason column and the source values, invalid cells marked as in the preview. An empty segment says why inside the table body. A stopped run adds a warning Alert with "Retry from row 121"; when nothing was saved, the empty Imported table carries the reason and Retry instead. Other props, `ref` included, go to its root.

props.name: mapping
props.description: Which columns map to which fields: the tables show the mapped fields.

props.name: validation
props.description: validateCsv's result.

props.name: imported
props.description: Valid rows saved: the first `imported` of them, in file order (onProgress counts them in order).

props.name: status
props.description: `stopped` when the run failed or was cancelled before the last row: adds Not imported.

props.name: reason
props.description: Why a stopped run stopped (the rejected promise's message). Without it, it was cancelled.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Adds Retry to a stopped result: "Retry from row 121", or Retry in the empty table when nothing was saved.

props.name: overLimit
props.description: Rows past `maxRows`: a muted line under the heading.

props.name: noun
props.description: "lead" / "leads". Defaults to the `csvRowNoun` label.

props.name: defaultFilter
props.description: Defaults to `imported`.

props.name: headers
props.description: The file's column names, for the skipped rows file (csvHeaders). Defaults to "Column 1"…

props.name: fileName
props.description: The file's name: the skipped rows file is `<name>-skipped.csv`.

props.name: delimiter
props.description: The skipped rows file's delimiter: the source file's (CsvParseResult.delimiter).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables Retry.

props.name: onImport
props.type: (rows: Record<string, string>[], ctx: CsvImportContext) => void | Promise<void>
props.description: Gets only the valid rows, keyed by field, normalised (text trimmed, an enum as its option's value, a number as "1234.5", a date as yyyy-mm-dd), once Import is pressed. Report progress with `onProgress` and honour `signal` for Cancel. A rejected promise shows its message with Retry in the result; void or a resolved promise is done. Retry resumes: it calls `onImport` again with only the rows after the last `onProgress(done)` count, so report a row done once it is saved. `onProgress` in that call counts from 0 again; the panel adds what was done before. After Cancel, `onProgress` still counts (the screen keeps what it showed at Cancel), so a request already in flight that commits is not sent again by the next Import or Retry.

props.name: noun
props.description: "lead" / "leads": used in "Import 328 leads". Defaults to the `csvRowNoun` label.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Data rows to import at most. Rows past it are counted and reported, never imported.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Largest file, in bytes.

props.name: templateHref
props.description: A template CSV to download, linked under the drop zone.

props.name: file
props.description: A file given from the start is read at once and opens on Map columns. A new one given later starts on Upload, as an added file does, and ends an import of the old one.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Called with the step on screen as it changes.

props.name: defaultMapping
props.description: Wins over auto-match for its columns.

props.name: onMappingChange
props.description: Called with each change, and with the auto-matched mapping when a new file is read.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Adds Done to the footer of the result.

props.name: cancelable
props.description: Shows Cancel while importing: `onImport` honours its `signal`.

props.name: appIcon
props.description: Your app's mark, where the file goes: in the drop zone's picture (a 24px box on a 40px muted tile) and the mapping card's heading (16px). Give it `className="size-full"`. Defaults to a database glyph.

props.name: inDialog
props.description: Inside a Dialog with no header of its own: each step's title and description become the dialog's DialogTitle and DialogDescription, its name and description.

props.name: onBrowse
props.description: Called in place of the file picker, from Browse files and from a click on the drop zone (a demo can drop a sample file with it). Left out, both open the picker.

props.name: dragging
props.description: Shows the drop zone as files dragged over it would (state sheets, docs).
